description: The chart illustrates performance metrics for several SimCSE-based sentence embedding models by showing three measures per model: Sentiment Accuracy, STS Correlation, and Paraphrase Accuracy. The category axis is horizontal and lists four model variants in left-to-right order: SimCSE, Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE. The value axis is vertical, labeled “Accuracy / Correlation,” and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks at approximately 0.2 intervals (e.g., 0.2, 0.4, 0.6), extending to around 0.9–1.0 near the top. Each category contains a grouped set of three vertical bars: a light beige bar for “Sentiment Acc.”, a pink bar for “STS Corr.”, and a light blue bar for “Paraphrase Acc.”. For SimCSE, the beige bar is around 0.55, the pink bar around 0.53, and the blue bar around 0.80. For Unsupervised_SimCSE, the beige bar is around 0.62, the pink bar around 0.67, and the blue bar around 0.85. For Supervised_SimCSE, the beige bar is around 0.68, the pink bar around 0.88, and the blue bar around 0.92. For 2-Tier SimCSE, the beige bar is around 0.75, the pink bar is near the top of the axis (approximately 0.95–1.0), and the blue bar is also near the top (approximately 0.95–1.0). The bars are not shown as stacked; they are grouped side-by-side within each model, and there is no visual indication of sorting beyond the fixed left-to-right model listing, nor any special emphasis such as outlines or annotations beyond the legend and axis labels.
